## 操作任务
实现install(request,case)。平台已有owned_base、owned_overlay及priority10的owned_low。PUT owned_overlay为template.settings.refresh_interval=12s及mappings.properties environment/event_kind都keyword；PUT owned_high为index_patterns=[teaching-*],priority20,composed_of=[owned_base,owned_overlay]，自身template.settings.refresh_interval=2s和aliases.teaching_read={}。POST _index_template/_simulate_index/批准case.new，随后PUT新索引空对象，返回实际模拟JSON。非200/201 RuntimeError。不得修改base、low或已有teaching-old；验收实际新索引和模拟合并结果、priority选中与原索引不变。不改输入。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7 component/composable template、simulate API与实际建索引优先级/覆盖对照。原索引不变作为保护条件，不再为016模板非追溯原则重复转换计数；不证明生产模板升级或迁移完成。

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status in (200,201),(method,path,status,value)
 return value
def docs(server,index):return {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000')['hits']['hits']}
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 case={'new':'teaching-new'}
 base={'template':{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0,'refresh_interval':'5s'},'mappings':{'properties':{'service':{'type':'keyword'}}}}}
 overlay={'template':{'settings':{'refresh_interval':'10s'},'mappings':{'properties':{'event_kind':{'type':'keyword'}}}}}
 low={'index_patterns':['teaching-*'],'priority':10,'template':{'settings':{'number_of_shards':2,'number_of_replicas':0},'mappings':{'properties':{'service':{'type':'text'}}}}}
 call(server,'PUT','/_component_template/owned_base',base);call(server,'PUT','/_component_template/owned_overlay',overlay);call(server,'PUT','/_index_template/owned_low',low)
 call(server,'PUT','/teaching-old');call(server,'PUT','/teaching-old/_doc/protected?refresh=true',{'service':'legacy-value'})
 protected=call(server,'GET','/teaching-old/_settings');oldmap=call(server,'GET','/teaching-old/_mapping');olddata=docs(server,'teaching-old')
 base_before=call(server,'GET','/_component_template/owned_base');low_before=call(server,'GET','/_index_template/owned_low');before=copy.deepcopy(case)
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_EXISTING_LOW_PRIORITY_TEXT_INDEX_AND_UNSELECTED_COMPONENTS',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:compose_components_choose_priority_simulate_then_create_actual_new_index',flush=True)
 try:simulated=task.install(server.request,case)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual component/template integration failed') from error
 actual=call(server,'GET','/'+case['new']+'/_settings')[case['new']]['settings']['index'];mapping=call(server,'GET','/'+case['new']+'/_mapping')[case['new']]['mappings']['properties']
 assert actual['number_of_shards']=='1' and actual['number_of_replicas']=='0' and actual['refresh_interval']=='2s'
 assert mapping=={'service':{'type':'keyword'},'environment':{'type':'keyword'},'event_kind':{'type':'keyword'}}
 assert simulated['template']['mappings']['properties']==mapping and simulated['template']['settings']['index']['refresh_interval']=='2s'
 assert any(row['name']=='owned_low' for row in simulated['overlapping']) and 'teaching_read' in simulated['template']['aliases']
 assert call(server,'GET','/_alias/teaching_read')[case['new']]['aliases']['teaching_read']=={}
 assert call(server,'GET','/_component_template/owned_base')==base_before and call(server,'GET','/_index_template/owned_low')==low_before
 assert call(server,'GET','/teaching-old/_settings')==protected and call(server,'GET','/teaching-old/_mapping')==oldmap and docs(server,'teaching-old')==olddata and case==before
 print('NATIVE_COMPONENT_MERGE_TEMPLATE_OVERRIDE_PRIORITY_SIMULATION_EQUALS_NEW_MAPPING_OLD_UUID_MAPPING_DATA_UNCHANGED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

body:
## 操作任务
实现classify(request,index,fields)。先size100 match_all取得原_source，再逐field实际exists查询；返回{field:{source_present:原文含该键的排序ID列表,indexed_present:真实exists排序ID列表}}。HTTP非200/timed_out/failed抛RuntimeError，不根据JSON真假值推断exists，不改输入/数据。平台原生对照null、空数组、仅null数组、空字符串、混合数组、缺键、index=false/doc_values=false及null_value映射，原文存在与索引存在分别验收。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7 exists与_source，两种不同存在语义和显式null_value映射。没有使用ignore_above长度机制，避免将021长值聚合问题重复算作独立工作；有限样本不证明全量大索引扫描完整性。

## 操作任务
实现find(request,object_index,nested_index)。相同items数组分别以object/nested映射存储，筛color=red且size=L。object用普通bool.filter两term；nested必须同一个nested(path=items,score_mode=none)内bool.filter两term。各size100实际_search，非200 RuntimeError。返回{object:排序ID,nested:排序ID}。不能用两个独立nested谓词冒充同一元素合取，不改数据。原生交叉元素样本仅object匹配、同元素样本两者均匹配；平台再改同一子项验证真实匹配变化。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7相同数组object展平与nested同元素谓词作用域、动态子项变化。与advanced002子项/父项聚合计数不同，辅助nested建模共享不额外计数；不宣称大数组更新成本验收。
